items.title: What ExxonMobil Stock's Guyana Expansion Means For Shareholders
items.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings has approved a US$12.5b Longtail development in Guyana and started production at Uaru, its fifth Stabroek block project, adding another large FPSO and around 45 planned subsea wells to an already substantial offshore program. items.title: 4 High Yield Stocks That Have Never Missed a Dividend Payment
items.summary: Recessions, oil crashes, and a pandemic failed to interrupt the quarterly checks from four household-name payers. But an unbroken record is a lower bar than it sounds, so we stress-tested each one on cash flow and debt before trusting the next payment.
